title: Chaos Engineering in the Wild: Findings from GitHub
abstract: arXiv:2505.13654v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chaos Engineering (CE) enhances system resilience by deliberately injecting faults to uncover weaknesses before they cause outages. Despite the availability of many CE tools, little is known about how they are adopted and maintained in open-source software (OSS) projects. This study empirically characterizes the adoption, evolution, and practical use of CE tools in OSS projects, examining who adopts them, how they are maintained, and which fault types they target. We conducted a large-scale mining study of GitHub repositories associated with ten widely used CE tools. Starting from 5,410 candidate repositories, we systematically filtered and manually validated 1,275 records and analyzed repository metadata, commit histories, and documentation. translated_title: 真实场景中的混沌工程：来自 GitHub 的发现
translated_abstract: 混沌工程通过有意注入故障来揭示系统弱点，从而在故障引发停机之前提升系统韧性。尽管已有众多混沌工程工具可用，但人们对这些工具在开源软件（OSS）项目中的采用和维护情况知之甚少。本研究实证性地刻画了混沌工程工具在开源项目中的采用、演进和实际使用情况，考察了谁在采用这些工具、它们如何被维护，以及它们针对哪些故障类型。我们对与十种广泛使用的混沌工程工具相关的 GitHub 仓库开展了大规模挖掘研究：从 5,410 个候选仓库出发，系统性地筛选并人工验证了 1,275 条记录，进而分析了仓库元数据、提交历史和文档。研究发现，工具采用集中于少数几个工具，其中 Toxiproxy、Chaos Mesh 和 Chaos Monkey 占已验证仓库的 68.86%。在采用者背景方面，开发（者相关内容，摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究对 GitHub 上与十种主流混沌工程工具相关的仓库进行了大规模实证挖掘，揭示了开源项目对混沌工程工具的采用高度集中于少数工具（Toxiproxy、Chaos Mesh 和 Chaos Monkey 合计占 68.86%）。
en_tdlr: A large-scale empirical study of GitHub repositories linked to ten widely used Chaos Engineering tools reveals that adoption in open-source projects is highly concentrated in a few tools, with Toxiproxy, Chaos Mesh, and Chaos Monkey accounting for 68.86% of validated repositories.
